# `csharp_wrap_parameters_style`

chop_always gives every parameter its own line regardless of width.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `chop_always` |  |
| `chop_if_long` |  |

**Default:** `chop_if_long`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Register(string name, int value, bool active, string tag)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(name);
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_parameters_style = chop_always`

```editorconfig
csharp_wrap_parameters_style = chop_always
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Register(
        string name,
        int value,
        bool active,
        string tag
    )
    {
        Console.WriteLine(name);
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_parameters_style = chop_if_long`

```editorconfig
csharp_wrap_parameters_style = chop_if_long
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
